defects.summary: The new priority field is added to the model, JSON, CLI and list output but export_csv still writes only id, title and done; the task asks for a priority column after title.
from_dict uses 'data.get("priority") or DEFAULT_PRIORITY', so the valid, most urgent priority 0 is replaced by the default 2 whenever a saved file is loaded.
test_export_csv used to compare the whole CSV text; it now only checks two substrings, which still pass when the priority column is missing (and would fail once it is added).

decoys.summary: by_priority sorts ascending on (priority, id): 0 is the most urgent priority, so ascending order lists the most urgent first and ties by id, as specified.
The next id is max(existing ids) + 1 computed on every add; the board never deletes tasks, so ids cannot be reused.
